## Control And Precedence

This is the single controlling manifest for the complete final
`SCI-JINC v0.1/r0.3` authority set. It supersedes
`AUTHOR_PACKET_MANIFEST.md` only as the final reader entry point. The original
manifest remains the exact Stage A input/firewall object and is included below
with all sixteen admitted objects and covers. No original admitted source is
broadened, rewritten, or silently replaced.

Authority precedence is:

1. the exact original admitted objects, each only in the role permitted by
   its cover;
2. the targeted r0.2 and r0.3 scientific-owner directives for the bounded
   repairs they authorize;
3. `SCI-JINC-DEC-PHASE-CENTER-001`, which binds the separately approved phase
   and center statements;
4. the final owner-review/freeze-preflight directive for acceptance, freeze
   disposition, and process controls; and
5. the six final shared canonical modules as the single normative expression
   of `SCI-JINC v0.1/r0.3` across both human-facing views.

The scientist-facing rationale and engineering-facing specification import
the same six modules exactly once in the same order. If view prose is narrower
or less detailed, the shared modules control. Verification evidence checks
the frozen bytes but adds no scientific content.

## Freeze Disposition And Limits

`SCI-JINC v0.1/r0.3` is a conditional, implementation-independent scientific
authority. It defines the generic analytic and discrete JINC operator; signed
accumulation and normalization; algebraic cancellation support; the five-role
observation bundle; grouping, lifecycle, ownership, and fail-closed behavior;
and the requirements for a future numerical-adequacy profile and certificate.

It does not authorize a numerical TolTEC JINC route until all separately owned
inputs are available, including:

- a registered, selected, realized JINC-permitted PTC coefficient family;
- an owner-authorized TolTEC array parameter set; and
- where numerical support is claimed, an exact numerical-adequacy profile with
  a matching realization certificate.

No inherited 45 m denominator, inherited shape value, mode-dependent
`r_max`, PTC family, hidden default, response/covariance/exposure product, MAP
inheritance, implementation behavior, or broader provenance/diagnostic
framework is authorized.

This freeze establishes no implementation conformity, representation
fidelity, response or covariance fidelity, parameter adequacy, photometric or
astrometric performance, observational validation, readiness, production, or
production authorization. Any later scientific correction shall be a
versioned successor and shall not modify these frozen bytes.

This manifest intentionally omits its own SHA-256. The exact local Git commit
and lightweight tag `sci-jinc-v0.1-r0.3` bind this manifest and every listed
repository object as one immutable snapshot. The final mechanical verification
report records the manifest digest and tag resolution after the bytes are
closed.
